name: Shishikura Ouga
source:
Kento's childhood friend. For unknown reason, they have always been in the same class since they were young. She is an extremely shy girl and becomes quiet when in front of others, but talks a lot when she is with Kento, whom she trusts the most. Ouga is the daughter of Shishikura Yotsuba, who is considered to be the strongest woman in Japan.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1206724]Getchu[/url]]
